title: The Song Nobody Could Finish
central_conflict: the school band and choir kept landing on different notes at the finale
decisive_choice: the brass players had been given a score transposed for a different instrument
resolution: printed the correct parts and rehearsed the ending with everyone together
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered the school band and choir kept landing on different notes at the finale before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they rehearsed each section separately but the final chord still clashed; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the brass players had been given a score transposed for a different instrument; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they printed the correct parts and rehearsed the ending with everyone together, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Celebration Held on the Wrong Day
central_conflict: half the town arrived for a holiday feast while the tables were still being built
decisive_choice: the invitation printer had mixed day-month and month-day date formats
resolution: sent corrected invitations with the month written out and held one shared feast
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered half the town arrived for a holiday feast while the tables were still being built before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they reread the invitations but each group insisted its date was correct; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the invitation printer had mixed day-month and month-day date formats; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they sent corrected invitations with the month written out and held one shared feast, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Stage That Leaned During the Dance
central_conflict: the floating festival stage tilted whenever the performers gathered
decisive_choice: the equipment and audience had all been placed on the same side of the pontoons
resolution: closed the stage for a balanced-load inspection and reopened after a safe test
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered the floating festival stage tilted whenever the performers gathered before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they tightened the stage ropes but it leaned further with every dancer; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the equipment and audience had all been placed on the same side of the pontoons; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they closed the stage for a balanced-load inspection and reopened after a safe test, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
